_meta.changelog: v2.3 (2026-08-04): NEUTRAL park DEFAULT RAISED 0.70 -> 0.80 (config F1 / "Aggressive-lite"). This is a PERMANENT DEFAULT change, not a per-plan override: the user's instruction (via Mike, Discord, ~10:41 ICT 2026-08-04) was to REPLACE the standing 0.70, and this file's own v2.1 enforcement clause named exactly that path ("changing the engine DEFAULT away from 0.70 requires user approval applied to LIVE"). risk_dial_override is therefore NOT consumed by this decision — it is RE-POINTED and stays ARMED for any level != 0.80 (e.g. a future F2=0.85, or a revert), so a plan running the default needs no confirmation fields while a plan proposing a NEW level is still hard-blocked by Mafee without them. The reasoning for not demanding those two fields on every daily plan is recorded verbatim in risk_dial_override._why_default_not_per_plan (a gate that fires every single day stops carrying information — the exact failure mode v2.1 was written to prevent). EVIDENCE RE-BASED: the v2.1 citation target measured_tradeoff_job_130720 is a 2026-07-03 vintage (ticker_prune, LAG_ADV_BASIS=close) holding NO 0.80 or 0.85 row, so citing it for a 0.80 decision would quote numbers that do not describe the chosen level; it is retained but clearly marked STALE and superseded by the new evidence_current_F1_2026-08-04 block (source mike/agents/Taylor/research/park_wiring_two_options_20260804.md, jobs Taylor_20260804_012953 / _022423, quant-skeptic CONFIRMED 2026-08-04T02:16:40Z). On ONE comparable current vintage (universe_pit, LAG_ADV_BASIS=price, NAV 50B, self-check 0 VND, no-op gate PASS): park 0.70 = CAGR 28.86% / Sharpe 1.90 / MaxDD -17.8% / Calmar 1.62; park 0.80 = CAGR 29.85% / Sharpe 1.87 / MaxDD -18.3% / Calmar 1.63 (Calmar peak of the whole sweep); 0.85 = 30.51% / 1.86 / -18.9% / 1.62; 0.90 = 31.01% / 1.84 / -19.5% / 1.59 (rejected — range boundary, plateau breaks). Bootstrap P(MaxDD<-30%) 2.2% -> 2.8% going 0.70 -> 0.80; realised average equity share 60.4% -> 63.1%; per-year LOO edge positive in every cell (+0.71..+1.25pp). N_trials 7 this round (~16 cumulative on this axis, not poolable across vintages); DSR = 1.0000 on all 7 legs = SATURATED and explicitly NOT usable as safety evidence; PBO(CAGR) = 0.080 (robust) vs PBO(Sharpe) = 0.411 (noise) — both family statistics, neither ranks an individual config. The risk anchor stays MaxDD ~ -30% (the liq<=0 fidelity bug is still open, so every MaxDD quoted here is a lower bound). WIRING STATE, stated plainly: the L1 sell rail exists as a READ-ONLY proposal script (mike/bin/compute_park_trim.py + mike/bin/park_holdings.py + P0 book/play_type tagging in trading_bot/executor.py._journal(); quant-skeptic CONFIRMED high 2026-08-04T03:16:01Z, re-derived against live DNSE to the VND) and every proposed order still passes requires_user_approval + the Mafee plan-bound gate — nothing here grants auto-execution. L2 (JIT unpark) deliberately NOT wired (L1-before-L2). NOT YET DONE, and it blocks true F1 behaviour: the engine BUY rail deploy_golive_dt5g_v4/golive_recommend_v23.py:96 ETF_PARK = {3: 0.7} still publishes 0.70 into data/golive_v23_status.json, so today the book would be bought up to 70% and only trimmed above 80% — a hybrid that was never backtested. See neutral_parking.pending_engine_consistency; that one-line engine change needs its own user/Mike go-ahead and was deliberately NOT made by job Taylor_20260804_034133. | v2.2 (2026-08-03): added capit_margin_lever block (DISABLED, enabled=false) — margin on the CAPIT bear-washout sleeve only, fixed f=1.3, gate dd52<=-20%, DNSE RocketX package 1840, SpaceX only. Wiring + rehearsal complete (job Taylor_20260803_122554, report mike/agents/Taylor/research/margin_kelly_production_wiring_20260803.md); ZERO live behaviour change while enabled=false. Scope is exactly what the p1-p5 research chain verified (p5 engine tier, quant-skeptic CONFIRMED-medium: dCAGR +0.663pp, dMaxDD worse 0.067pp, DSR 1.0, PBO 0.10-0.14) — NOT the p4 proxy numbers (+1.82pp), which p5 showed inflate both directions. Flipping enabled=true requires a separate explicit user confirmation; no agent may flip it. | v2.1 (2026-07-03): added neutral_parking section (governance policy, not a research change) — codifies the engine default that at DT5G NEUTRAL with 0 active BAL/LAG deals, idle cash parks into custom30V at 70% OF THE IDLE POOL (not a total-equity cap). Reason: go-live 2026-07-01 DollarBill wrote target_equity_pct=93.8% straight into a trade plan JSON that passed no policy/backtest gate; user caught it via direct questioning; backtest confirmed 70% is the risk-adjusted optimum. Evidence pinned: jobs Taylor_20260703_113818 (70 vs 94 isolated, quant-skeptic CONFIRMED 11:57:15), _120555 (70-100 sweep, no inflection), _130720 (CANONICAL full 2-book NAV: park0.70 CAGR26.83/Sh1.78/DD-16.5/Cal1.63 DOMINATES park0.94 28.01/1.66/-18.8/1.49 and park1.00 29.30/1.65/-19.3/1.52 on Sharpe+Calmar+MaxDD every window), _153738 (70 = properly-tested level, not a taste floor). Spyros implements in risk_monitor.py (S4 breach = BOT_STOP + Telegram + halt-review flag for first 6m go-live). v1.7 (2026-06-26): added macro_kill_switches section (3 RECOVERY_PARK suspend conditions required by Spyros's v24-golive-risk-review sign-off, 2026-06-23) ahead of go-live 2026-06-30 — (A) SBV deposit rate >7.5% -> suspend new recovery deploy (outer hard-stop on top of the money_condition throttle); (B) median liquid-universe pb_z > -0.3 while a recovery episode is active -> tighten (stop adding, market no longer cheap; -0.5-in/-0.3-out hysteresis vs deep_cheap_recovery_override episode-open); (C) cumulative intra-episode NAV drawdown > -12% from episode entry -> HALT via BOT_STOP (knife-catching circuit breaker, distinct from the intraday -5% brake). All are SUSPEND (auto-arming, not permanent-off) except (C) which needs human review to restart. v1.6 (2026-06-23): deep_cheap_recovery_override ceiling TIGHTENED 1.50 -> 1.30. v1.5 (2026-06-23): money_condition dep_floor 0.06->0.075. v1.4 (2026-06-22): added money_condition.

neutral_parking._principle: When DT5G state == NEUTRAL and the two core books (BAL momentum + LAG PEAD) have NO deal meeting their entry standard at that moment, the IDLE portion of NAV is parked into the custom30V yieldcombo sleeve at a FIXED 80% of that idle pool (was 70% from v2.1 until v2.3, 2026-08-04 — see changelog). This 80% is a fraction of the IDLE POOL (idle_pool = NAV - active_BAL_LAG_stock_value), NOT a cap on total portfolio equity: when BAL/LAG DO hold real deals, total stock exposure can run far above 80% of NAV (by design — this rule does not apply then, it governs only what to do with the leftover cash). The rule exists to close the go-live gap where a target equity % was written straight into a trade plan without passing any policy/backtest gate (see _meta changelog v2.1).
neutral_parking.default_park_note: PARK 80% of idle cash into custom30V (30 names, name_cap 0.10, gate rating<=3, yieldcombo 1/PE+1/PCF). Level = config F1, user-confirmed 2026-08-04 via Mike (Discord), replacing the 0.70 that stood from v2.1 (2026-07-03). Exactly ONE parameter changed vs the pinned spec (0.70 -> 0.80); band 0.005, FIFO, _etf_day_cap all unchanged. This is the engine default, NOT a discretionary floor and NOT a ceiling to be topped up to by hand.

evidence_current_F1_2026-08-04.multiple_testing: N_trials = 7 this round (target x band on the full engine), ~16 cumulative on this axis across 3 harnesses/vintages (NOT poolable across vintages — disclosed). evidence_current_F1_2026-08-04.per_year_LOO: dropping any single year, F1's edge vs 0.70 stays positive across the whole 2014-2026 grid: +0.71pp (weakest cell, 2022) to +1.25pp (2021), full-sample +1.01pp. No year carries the edge — passes the Wave1/H8a single-year-carry check.

Higher target actually means LESS daily trim pressure (L1 only sells the excess above target). Capacity does not discriminate between 0.70 / 0.80 / 0.85 at current NAV.

risk_dial_override._principle: The NEUTRAL park level is a risk-appetite dial the user MAY move in either direction away from the standing default (up = more equity beta / more nominal CAGR / deeper tail; down = the reverse). Moving it must be a CONSCIOUS, logged choice, never a silent default that slips into a plan. Same guardrail pattern as deep_cheap_recovery_override / v25_leverage: OFF until an explicit, evidence-acknowledged user confirmation is present.
risk_dial_override.status: ARMED for any level != 0.80 — the default itself moved to 0.80 on 2026-08-04 (see default_change_record_2026-08-04), so plans running the default need NO override fields. A plan proposing 0.85 (F2), 0.70, 0.90 or anything else DOES need them.
risk_dial_override._why_default_not_per_plan: Decision taken 2026-08-04 (Taylor, job Taylor_20260804_034133), reasoning recorded so it can be argued with later: (1) the user's instruction was to REPLACE the standing 0.70 ('thay mức 0.70 hiện hành'), i.e. a standing level, not a one-off deviation on one day's plan; (2) this file's own enforcement clause already names that path — 'changing the engine DEFAULT away from 0.70 requires user approval applied to LIVE' — and that approval now exists; (3) requiring risk_dial_confirmed_by_user on EVERY daily plan for the level that IS the approved default would turn the field into copy-paste boilerplate, and a gate that fires every single day stops carrying information — which is exactly the failure mode v2.1 was written to prevent (a number flowing into a plan with nobody actually deciding it); (4) keeping the gate armed for levels != 0.80 preserves the original protection for the genuinely undecided cases (F2 0.85 and above, or any revert). The per-plan mechanism is NOT removed — it is re-pointed from 0.70 to 0.80.

risk_dial_override.rule: Any trade plan that sets NEUTRAL parking != 0.80 (of idle pool; 0.80 is the default since 2026-08-04) MUST carry BOTH fields: (1) risk_dial_confirmed_by_user: true; (2) risk_dial_warning_acknowledged quoting the risk-adjusted cost of the CHOSEN level from evidence_current_F1_2026-08-04, which holds 0.70 / 0.80 / 0.85 / 0.90 on one comparable vintage — do NOT cite the stale measured_tradeoff_job_130720 numbers, they hold no 0.80/0.85 row and are a different vintage. If EITHER field is missing, Mafee (2nd gate) MUST BLOCK the plan. A plan running the default 0.80 needs NEITHER field.

required_fields.risk_dial_confirmed_by_user: boolean — must be literally true; a plan proposing park!=0.80 without it is blocked.
required_fields.risk_dial_warning_acknowledged: string/object — must quote the risk-adjusted cost table from evidence_current_F1_2026-08-04 (park_wiring_two_options_20260804.md), NOT measured_tradeoff_job_130720. A generic acknowledgement without the actual numbers does NOT satisfy the gate.

risk_dial_override.enforcement: DollarBill must not set park!=0.80 without user instruction + both fields. Mafee hard-blocks any plan with NEUTRAL parking != 0.80 lacking either field (same mechanical block as an over-limit order). Changing the engine DEFAULT away from 0.80 again requires user approval applied to LIVE (owners rule) — record it in default_change_history plus a new _meta changelog entry, never edit the number silently.

deep_cheap_recovery_override.condition: ALL THREE: (1) DT5G state in {CRISIS, BEAR}; (2) median liquid-universe pb_z <= -0.7 (GENUINELY cheap vs own 5Y history — NOT cheap-vs-recent-peak; falling-knife filter: REJECTED Jun-2022 pb_z +0.75 despite -25% from top, FIRED at COVID-2020 pb_z -0.78); (3) money_condition below — system deposit rate LOW enough that cash opportunity-cost does not beat deploying.

money_condition.rule: scale the recovery deploy / >1.0x leverage budget by m = clip((dep_ceiling - deposit_rate)/(dep_ceiling - dep_floor), 0, 1); dep_floor=0.075, dep_ceiling=0.12. Deploy/lever fully only when deposit<=7.5%; ZERO extra deploy when deposit>=12% (hold cash even if pb_z cheap). Linear throttle between.
money_condition.why: 2011-extension backtest (backtest_recovery_alloc_2011.py, 2026-06-22): deploying into the 2012 deep-cheap crisis LOST to baseline because deposit was 14% (cash earned 14% risk-free) + the recovery was L-shaped/slow. The deposit-gate restored 2011-13 to baseline (+8.4%), kept the 2020 win, gave best full-period CAGR 12.8%/Sharpe 1.11/Calmar 0.68. Encodes 'cautious when macro bad' + 'cheapness vs deposit rate' using the RELIABLE deposit series (pre-2014 PE is corrupt -> a 1/PE Fed-gate is unusable).
money_condition.floor_calibration: dep_floor=0.075 (DORMANT) chosen over 0.06 (ACTIVE) after measuring both in pt_v23 (2026-06-23): floor=0.075 -> avg m=1.00 -> CAGR 31.81% BYTE-IDENTICAL to baseline (gate never bit, deposit <=7.5% all of 2014-26). floor=0.06 -> avg m=0.85 -> 30.83% (-0.98pp, worse Sharpe/MaxDD/Calmar) because it wrongly trimmed the 2022 SCB-hike deploy which then recovered strongly in 2023. floor=0.075 distinguishes a TRUE high-rate crisis (>7.5%, 2012-like) from a moderate defensive hike. Consistent with the post-2011 disciplined-SBV macro-view.
money_condition.dormancy: deposit has been <=7.5% throughout 2014-2026 -> at floor=0.075 this gate is DORMANT in the DT5G era (m=1, ZERO change to the pinned recovery-park 31.81%, self-check 0 VND). It is FORWARD INSURANCE that only arms if rates spike >7.5% in a future crisis. Same fail-safe-not-return-enhancer profile as DT5G itself.
money_condition.source: deposit_rate_vn.DEPOSIT_EVENTS (Big-4 12M term, causal/announced); Mafee/Winston confirm the live deposit figure feeding any LIVE use.

macro_kill_switches._principle: Three macro/episode-level suspends on the RECOVERY_PARK (deep-cheap deploy) sleeve, required by Spyros's v24-golive-risk-review sign-off (2026-06-23) before go-live 2026-06-30. They do NOT touch the static core book (BAL/LAG); they gate only the opportunistic recovery sleeve and any >1.0x lever portion. Owners: Spyros enforces via risk_monitor.py + BOT_STOP; DollarBill must not plan new recovery adds while any switch is armed; Mafee hard-blocks recovery-sleeve orders while armed.

A_sbv_rate_suspend.rationale: Outer hard-stop layer ON TOP of the existing deep_cheap_recovery_override.money_condition throttle (which already linearly scales deploy to 0 between deposit 7.5%->12%). At deposit >7.5% cash earns >=7.5% risk-free AND high-rate crises are historically L-shaped/slow (2012 SBV ~14% deep-cheap deploy LOST to baseline — backtest_recovery_alloc_2011.py). 7.5% = the dep_floor already pinned in money_condition; this switch is the discrete debounced suspend on top of the continuous throttle. DORMANT since 2014 (SBV <=6% throughout) — forward insurance for a future rate spike.

B_valuation_richening_suspend.trigger: median liquid-universe pb_z > -0.3 WHILE a RECOVERY episode is active
B_valuation_richening_suspend.source: median PB z-score across data/ticker_prune liquid universe vs each name's own 5Y history, causal (T-1). Same pb_z series that gates deep_cheap_recovery_override episode-open (<= -0.5) and the lever portion (<= -0.7).
B_valuation_richening_suspend.action: TIGHTEN — stop ADDING to the recovery sleeve (no new deploy); hold existing recovery positions. Auto-disarms (re-allows adds) only if pb_z falls back <= -0.5 (episode-open level).
B_valuation_richening_suspend.rationale: The recovery thesis is 'deploy WHILE genuinely cheap'. Episode opens at pb_z <= -0.5; once the universe richens back above -0.3 the cheapness edge is gone and continuing to deploy is chasing a no-longer-cheap tape. The -0.5-in / -0.3-out asymmetric band is deliberate HYSTERESIS to avoid whipsaw around a single threshold. This is a sizing tightener, not a halt — it does not write BOT_STOP.

capit_margin_lever.sizing_effect: When active, the CAPIT capital target is multiplied by f: capit_total_target_vnd_levered = active_nav x w_lag_target x capit_size x f. The base (unlevered) fields keep their exact meaning and value so nothing downstream changes while disabled. The %ADV cap (capit_adv_caps) is NOT scaled by f — market-impact limits are independent of how the purchase is funded; leverage may therefore be partially clipped by liquidity at large NAV. Measured live scale (p5 1.3): heaviest single event borrows 25.9% of NAV (~243.5tr at NAV 938tr), average event 6.8% (~63.6tr) — and those are LOWER BOUNDS (p5 1.3 warning).
known_limits: N = 15 independent events. DSR/PBO computed on 3107 daily NAV points do NOT enlarge that N.
f* ~ 6.0 from the sleeve-level Kelly calc is NOT a recommendation — it assumes the historical event distribution repeats with no margin call and no liquidation slippage.

p5 4.2 could not explain why realized/predicted is 0.19x at f=1.1 and 0.41x at f=1.2 (it is 1.08x at f=1.3, 0.90x at f=1.5). f=1.3 was chosen because it is the best-explained level, not because it is optimal.

The transmission channel is narrow by construction: leverage lands on ~0.272 NAV-book of ONE of two books (~13.6% of total NAV), which is why a +4.52%/yr sleeve effect becomes +0.663pp portfolio-wide. Widening the channel is a DIFFERENT question with a different risk family — not researched, not approved.

exclusions._principle: Risk and reward travel together. We profit from cheapness via CALCULATED risk, not by reflexively avoiding any name with a legal cloud or a price crash. A crisis at a fundamentally REAL/good company is a potential cheap entry. Hard-ban ONLY when value is unknowable/fictitious; everything else gets ASSESSED, not avoided. (User standing principle 2026-06-22.)

hard_ban.criterion: value is UNKNOWABLE or FICTITIOUS — confirmed fraud, books under criminal investigation, or fabricated/non-cash earnings you cannot value. NOT for a real business under a legal cloud.

gap_adaptive_fill._status: PROPOSED (2026-06-29, Taylor) — paper-test first; LIVE needs user approval (real-money execution change). enabled=false until then.
gap_adaptive_fill._principle: Layer-3 fill timing becomes gap_z-CONDITIONAL. A buy-list name's alpha call is already made; this only changes WHEN/at-what-price to fill given an ABNORMAL open. Evidence: gap_adaptive_proxy.py (daily, N=408,622, IS+OOS) + gap_path_crosscheck.py (16-name true 1-min). Two-sided intraday overreaction mean-reversion, monotonic in gap_z, IS+OOS-stable.

down_gap.action: BUY-AT-OPEN: override the early-morning slow-down -> FULL SPEED in the open window 09:15-09:45 to capture the day's cheapest entry.
down_gap.why: On an abnormal down-gap the OPEN is the cheapest price of the day (price vs open is POSITIVE at every later checkpoint: 09:45 +113, 11:15 +101, ATC +181 bps on the 16-name set). Current rule waits to 10:45-11:15 -> pays ~+170-206 bps MORE per fill. Edge holds ALL liquidity tiers (Open->ATC 310-368 bps, t 9-28; ~173-206 bps saved vs 11:15). fwd20 positive every tier -> not a falling knife.

up_gap.note: NO CHANGE. Current rule (slow early morning, concentrate buys 10:45-11:15) already captures 86% of the up-gap give-back by 11:15. Optional ATC push for last ~14% judged not worth EOD execution risk.

gap_z_compute.today_open: first executable price after 09:15 ATO auction (broker quote); compute gap_z ONCE per order at first post-09:15 quote, then cache for the session.
gap_z_compute.prior_close: T-1 adjusted close (from the approved plan or daily feed).
gap_z_compute.rvol_20d: causal trailing-20d std of daily close-to-close returns, as-of T-1 (daily feed; Winston/data or precomputed at plan build).

guards.corp_action: if |gap| > 0.15 -> NO override (likely corp-action/adjustment artifact), fall back to current rule.
guards.rvol_freshness: rvol_20d missing / <=0 / stale -> NO override (FAIL-SAFE to current rule). Mirrors the B4 PE-freshness fail-closed pattern.
guards.buy_only: applies to BUY only; SELL unchanged.
guards.live_gate: gated behind existing fill_timing_live_gate (paper until user disables) AND a NEW gap_adaptive_enabled flag (default false). Both must be on for LIVE.

ev_blast_radius.saving_per_downgap_fill_bps: ~173-206 (vs current 11:15 rule); larger notional applies in stress years
ev_blast_radius.frequency: ~0.6-0.9% of buy-able days; CONCENTRATES in stress years (2018 1.38 / 2020 1.40 / 2025 1.53 / 2026 1.13%) = exactly when the recovery sleeve deploys most
ev_blast_radius.portfolio_ev: modest blended (~10-15 bps/yr) but FREE (pure execution, zero added risk) and concentrated at capitulation/deploy moments where notional is largest; removes the behavioral trap of mis-timing capitulation fills
ev_blast_radius.verdict: cheap, robust execution refinement — correctly sized as free-insurance + small edge, NOT a needle-mover

executor_spec.change: At top of the BUY branch, BEFORE the early-morning slow-down: if gap_adaptive_enabled AND down-gap override active for this ticker (gap_z<-2, guards pass) -> return 1.0 during 09:15-09:45 (full speed at open). After 09:45 fall through to the normal rule. UP-gap / normal: unchanged.
